name: Bagel.ai
description_en:
Bagel AI is a product-feedback and decision platform, not a general prose-writing tool. It connects customer signals from calls, support tickets, CRM and chat to accounts and commercial context, then proposes priorities and development-ready artifacts. An MCP connection can deliver that context to coding or other AI tools.

The official FAQ explicitly separates it from ByteDance’s similarly named Bagel model. Its placement in this catalog’s AI-writing category is an inherited classification issue, not evidence of a writing-first product. Revenue-linked prioritization, accuracy and outcome claims remain vendor descriptions; this profile did not validate them.
description_zh:
Bagel AI 是产品反馈与决策平台，不是通用写作工具，将通话、工单、CRM 和聊天信号关联到客户与商业上下文，再提出优先级和开发资料，并可通过 MCP 交给编程或其他 AI 工具。

官方 FAQ 明确区分 ByteDance 同名 Bagel 模型。目录 AI 写作分类是继承的归类问题，不证明产品以写作为主。收入关联排序、准确率及效果均为厂商描述，本文未验证。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate requests with customer/account context and proposed priorities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把请求与客户/账户上下文及建议优先级关联。

core_features.explanation_en: Serve scoped product evidence to connected AI tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: 向连接的 AI 工具提供范围明确的产品证据。

en: Turn support requests into a source-linked product-priority proposal.
zh: 把支持请求转成可追溯来源的产品优先级建议。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose a bounded feedback set and account mapping, agree the paid pilot, then compare recommendations with original evidence.
steps.zh: 选择有限反馈集和账户映射，约定付费试点，再将建议与原始证据核对。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual feedback-volume package, unlimited seats and separately priced paid pilot.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Pro from $24,000/year, twelve-month contract, unlimited seats; feedback volume determines scale, Enterprise quoted. Thirty-day pilot is paid, amount not established; cost credits toward first year only if continuing. No free version per official FAQ.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Pro 起年 $24,000、12 个月合同、席位不限，按反馈量扩展，Enterprise 询价。30 天试点付费，金额未确定，继续订阅才抵首年。官方 FAQ 明确无免费版。

sources.title: Bagel AI | Your Company Product Brain for AI-Native Teams
sources.research_notes_en: Product-feedback decision platform, explicitly distinct from ByteDance Bagel model; joins calls/tickets/accounts, prioritization and MCP delivery.

sources.title: Bagel AI Pricing: Product Brain From $24K a Year
sources.research_notes_en: Pro starts $24,000/year, unlimited seats, twelve-month contract and feedback-volume pricing; thirty-day pilot is paid and credited only if continuing.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Trace the recommendation back to the customer signal
sections.title_zh: 把推荐追溯到客户信号
sections.en: For an illustrative request to add an export feature, connect the underlying support ticket and affected account instead of counting every repeated mention as a new customer. Review the proposed urgency, revenue association and owner against the source. A large deal is context, not proof that the feature causes retention or should outrank every strategic need. No connector, deduplication or recommendation was tested.
sections.zh: 例如增加导出功能，应关联原始工单和受影响账户，而不是每次重复提及都算新客户。应把建议紧急度、收入关联和负责人对照原始来源。大额交易是上下文，不证明该功能导致留存或应高于所有战略需求。本文未测连接、去重或推荐。

sections.title_en: Keep shared context and write authority separate
sections.title_zh: 区分共享上下文与写权限
sections.en: The site describes decisions and specs flowing to Jira, Linear, Slack and MCP-connected assistants. Confirm which objects can be read or changed, who can access source recordings and how a corrected account association propagates. A product recommendation served to a coding agent remains a decision requiring accountable ownership. Vendor accuracy, token savings and churn figures were not independently measured.
sections.zh: 官网描述决策与规格流向 Jira、Linear、Slack 和 MCP 助手，应确认可读写对象、谁可访问原始录音，以及账户关联更正如何传播。提供给编程 Agent 的推荐仍需有人负责决策。本文未独立测量准确率、token 节省或流失数字。

sections.title_en: The pilot is paid, not a free trial
sections.title_zh: 试点付费，不是免费试用
sections.en: Pro starts $24,000 yearly on a twelve-month contract, without per-seat fees. Price grows with feedback volume; additional connected tools are described as not changing price. Enterprise adds custom scope. The thirty-day pilot uses the customer’s data and includes setup/support; its cost is deducted from year one only if continuing. No pilot amount was established. Unlimited seats do not establish unlimited feedback ingestion or external AI spend.
sections.zh: Pro 起年 $24,000，12 个月合同，无按席位费；价格随反馈量增长，说明增加连接工具不改变价格，Enterprise 定制。30 天试点使用客户数据并含配置/支持，继续订阅才抵扣首年费用，未确定试点金额。不限席位不证明反馈摄入或外部 AI 费用不限。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the product-data programme rather than a writing subscription
sections.title_zh: 评估产品数据项目而非写作订阅
sections.en: Bagel AI merits investigation when customer evidence is fragmented and product teams need shared prioritization context. A personal writing assistant is a different need. Define connector permissions, source retention, commercial fields and a corrected-record test before a paid pilot. No source license, self-hosted package, data-region contract or measured outcome was verified. The catalog classification should be reviewed by the coordinator.
sections.zh: 客户证据分散、产品团队需要共同排序依据时可研究 Bagel AI，个人写作助手是另一需求。付费试点前应定义连接权限、来源保留、商业字段及更正记录测试。本次未确认源码许可、自托管、数据地区合同或测量效果，目录归类需协调方复核。

research_gaps: Inherited ai-writing category does not match the current product-feedback platform; shared taxonomy change deferred.
No connector, prioritization, deduplication, MCP, pilot or outcome test was performed.
Pilot fee, feedback units, data terms, model rights, source license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
